text: What is tromboning and why does it matter now?
choices: Backhauling cloud-destined traffic to a central data centre and out again, adding latency to precisely the traffic most sensitive to it
explanation: It made sense when everything lived in the data centre. Now that most traffic is cloud-destined, it consumes an expensive circuit carrying traffic that was never going to the data centre — which is the core argument for local breakout.
